description: This circular walk explores Boden Boo, a lovely riverside woodland area next to the River Clyde in Erskine. Boden Boo sits directly beneath the towering spans of the Erskine Bridge, which provides a dramatic architectural contrast to the natural scenery. The area is defined by a network of wide, easy-access paths that meander through a mix of young and mature woodland, making it a popular spot for families, dog walkers, and cyclists. A key highlight is the surprising sandy beach along the banks of the River Clyde, where you can enjoy views across the water to the craggy Kilpatrick Braes.The woodland and shoreline serve as a rich habitat for local wildlife and varied birdlife. As you wander among the trees, you might spot roe deer or squirrels, while the riverside is an excellent vantage point for seeing wading birds such as herons and oystercatchers. During the warmer months, the grassy slopes and riverside spots are ideal for picnics, offering a peaceful atmosphere despite the proximity to the bridge above. The paths are generally well-maintained and suitable for buggies, ensuring that the tranquil river views and forest trails are accessible for a gentle stroll at any time of year.You can continue your walking in the area on theLinwood Riverside Walk.
